record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Random Matrix Theory and the Theory of Integrable Systems. II
record.original_question: For the Korteweg–de Vries equation u_t + u u_x + u_xxx = 0 on the real line with almost periodic initial data u(x,0)=u_0(x), does the solution exist and evolve almost periodically in time whenever the spatial initial profile is almost periodic?

evidence.quote: This result leads to the following natural conjecture: The same is true if u0(x) is almost periodic, i.e., if the initial data is almost periodic in space, the solution evolves almost periodically in time.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the Korteweg–de Vries (KdV) equation on the real line,
   u_t + u u_x + u_{xxx} = 0,   x ∈ ℝ, t ∈ ℝ,
with initial condition u(x,0) = u_0(x). Recall that a bounded continuous function f : ℝ → ℝ is almost periodic (in the sense of Bohr) if for every ε > 0 the set of ε-almost-periods {τ ∈ ℝ : sup_{x∈ℝ} |f(x+τ) − f(x)| < ε} is relatively dense in ℝ; equivalently, the set of translates {f(· + s) : s ∈ ℝ} is precompact in the uniform topology on ℝ.

Suppose u_0 is almost periodic. Decide whether the following statement is true: for every almost periodic initial datum u_0, there exists a global solution u(x,t) of the KdV equation with u(·,0) = u_0 such that for every t ∈ ℝ the function x ↦ u(x,t) is almost periodic, and moreover for every fixed x ∈ ℝ the function t ↦ u(x,t) is almost periodic.
artifact.category_tag: KdV equation with almost periodic initial data
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture has been established for several restricted classes of almost periodic initial data (e.g., small analytic quasiperiodic data with Diophantine frequency vector by Binder–Damanik–Goldstein–Lukic, and reflectionless data with sufficiently thick absolutely continuous spectrum). However, in 2024 Chapouto, Killip, and Vişan constructed almost periodic initial data whose KdV evolution loses almost periodicity, thereby disproving the conjecture in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Almost Periodicity in Time of Solutions of the KdV Equation
status_evidence.snippet: Existence, uniqueness, and almost periodicity in time of solutions of KdV with small analytic quasiperiodic initial data with Diophantine frequency vector.
status_evidence.claim: Partial positive resolution for a class of almost periodic data.

status_evidence.title: Disproving the Deift conjecture: the loss of almost periodicity
status_evidence.snippet: Talk announcing construction of almost periodic initial data whose KdV evolution loses almost periodicity.
status_evidence.claim: Counterexample disproving the conjecture in general.

status_evidence.title: The Deift Conjecture: A Program to Construct a Counterexample
status_evidence.snippet: Outlines a program to construct a counterexample to Deift's conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Program leading to the eventual counterexample.
